name: hiran-skills
description: Hiran Patel's personal Claude skills library for CV tailoring, interview prep, and job search workflows

plugins.name: cv-tailoring
plugins.description: Tailors a CV to a job description, scores ATS keyword coverage via semantic clustering, and generates a timestamped DOCX saved to a local output folder. Includes board/investor, BI tool, and Design function assessment per role.

plugins.name: interview-prep
plugins.description: Builds interview intel from a JD and company name: company and named-interviewer research (incl. filings registries, hiring signals), STAR-format answers, smart questions, an intro, and engagement-type-aware HR-screen basics. Multi-round aware via transcript debrief; builds the presentation itself when a round requires one. Scales from a 10-minute rapid brief to a full dossier.
